title: A comprehensive review on the anti-cancer properties of sesame lignans: chemical composition, molecular mechanisms and prospects
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,45636-45664
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03511B, Review Article
Open Access

Min He, Jun Hu, Jiaxin Deng, Xueqiang Chen, Opeyemi Joshua Olatunji, Titilope John Jayeoye
This review presents a comprehensive report on recent advances in the chemical composition, structures, and diversity of sesame lignans, as well as their anti-cancer properties and underlying molecular mechanisms.
